title: India Plans ₹45,000 Crore Railway Upgrade along China, Pakistan and Bangladesh Borders

blocks.content: India plans to invest ₹45,000 crore in railway infrastructure along the borders with China, Pakistan and Bangladesh. The programme covers new tracks, platforms and network strengthening in border states and is scheduled for implementation over the next 18 to 24 months.

items: Indian Railways is one of the world’s largest rail networks under a single management system.
The Siliguri Corridor is a narrow land link in West Bengal that connects the north-east with the rest of India.
All-weather infrastructure is designed to function during rain, snow and other seasonal disruptions.
Railways are used in India for both civilian transport and strategic movement of goods and personnel.
